plan.name: v1.12.0
plan.info: Add dedicated media field to MsgPost with on-chain validation

title: Upgrade: v1.12.0
summary:
Adds a dedicated media field to MsgPost messages, allowing up to 10 HTTPS URLs per post. Media URLs are validated on-chain (https:// required, max 2048 characters per URL). The field is optional and backward compatible.

BINARY REQUIREMENT: All validators must update to v1.12.0 binary BEFORE the upgrade height.
